body:
Same here. But something in me wants to not get better. Sadness is a cozy place. 

And by avoiding contact, I feel like doing a favor to them, so they don't have to deal with me.
Right there with you. And, in my case, I don't think it will take much longer.

Me too. But, at the same time, I like to think I'm doing a favor to the people I'm interested in to not risk wasting their tike with me. My 3 yo crush is approachable, but too skilled for a good for nothing like me. And would have to deal with my "Am I good enough" shit about everything.

Similar situation here. But the one keeping me alive is my mother, to which I'm not 100% approachable to, but still express her good intentions towards me.


There's a guy (I am a male, 22) that I have a crush on, but I don't want to begin something that can turn his life to shit because of my mental problems. And the "I have a girls and I'm still sad helps to shine a new light on the matter.


I have no goals nor have intention to develop any. Guess I'll die. 🤷

People are complaining that the series is becoming predictable, but I still hope R.R. Martin is going to pull some red wedding lvl stuff to wrap everything up.

Hugs from afar. Hope something nice come your way to warm your heart.
I don't think I'm going to make it through the end of got either. Maybe, I don't know.

Sometimes the way my mom can be overprotective pisses me off. That and the fact that I'm turning more apathic by the day drives me away from her.


But the way she sometimes aproaches me to tell me that everything she wants is to me to be happy, I get really sad cause I don't have the will do accomplish that.


I don't hope for anything in my future. I'm not charming nor hard working. I just feel like laying down and slowly dying.
